# `kernel/SessionStore.js`

> **Source:** `webgpu-os/kernel/SessionStore.js`

SessionStore.js — operator-scoped, encrypted per-origin session + credential store. One account-and-device-bound AES-256-GCM AppSandbox per Realm Passport, shared by that operator's apps and compat layer. It replaces the Browser app's localStorage-local vault/cookie stores so logins and per-site policy are managed OS-wide and consistently encrypted. Record kinds (one IDB key each): policy:<origin>  → 'persist' | 'isolated'      per-site session policy sess:<origin>    → { cookies:{k:v}, local:{k:v}, t }   agent-captured data vault            → the Browser vault blob (itself master-password encrypted; stored here so all apps share one OS-wide vault) IMPORTANT — what this can and cannot do: We CANNOT read a cross-origin live frame's real cookies (browser isolation), and Set-Cookie is a forbidden header. So "persistence" is policy-driven: • 'isolated' (default) → frame loads `credentialless` (ephemeral, sessionless) • 'persist'            → frame drops `credentialless` so the browser keeps its cookies natively across reloads + restarts Captured `sess:<origin>` data only comes from surfaces we CONTROL (proxied / srcdoc / compat-sandbox documents) via an injected agent — never scraped from a live cross-origin frame.

## Notes & Examples

### Command Bus Pattern

The OS uses a capability-gated command bus for inter-app and system communication. Apps register command handlers; the kernel routes commands based on capabilities. Commands can be local (same app), cross-app (with permission), or system-level (elevated).

**Example: Command registration and invocation**
```js
import { CommandBus } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/CommandBus.js';
import { Capability } from 'webgpu-os/kernel/Capability.js';

const bus = new CommandBus();

// Register a handler (requires 'ui' capability)
bus.register('myapp:openFile', async (path) => {
  const content = await storage.read(path);
  return { content, size: content.length };
}, { capability: 'storage' });

// Invoke locally
const result = await bus.invoke('myapp:openFile', '/docs/readme.md');

// Cross-app invocation (requires 'interop' capability)
const otherApp = bus.proxy('otherapp');
const data = await otherApp.invoke('otherapp:compute', input);

// Broadcast to all listening apps
bus.broadcast('system:themeChanged', { theme: 'dark' });
```

**See also:** [WebGPU OS Architecture](/webgpu-os/architecture.md) · [Security Model](/concepts/security-model.md)
